rationale: The schema change widens field 2 (quantity) from int32 to int64. The ts-proto forceLong=string configuration means int64 fields are represented as canonical decimal strings in generated TypeScript. The Request interface already declares quantity as string (line 4). The encoder call on line 9 was incorrectly converting the string to a JS number via Number.parseInt, which would lose precision for values >2^53-1. The fix passes the canonical decimal string directly to the encoder, preserving exact int64 precision. Line 10 (entity.quantity.toString()) and line 11 (BigInt(entity.quantity) > 0n) already correctly handle the decoded string value and require no changes.
